props.gloss_en: Rava: [a hole] below the wine too is 'to strain'; 'to reinforce' is where it was perforated below the sediment
a sealed house has four cubits; if he broke its doorposts, it does not have four cubits
a sealed house does not defile all around it; if he broke its doorposts, it defiles all around it
the reed [inserted as a spout]: Rav forbids
...and Shmuel permits
cutting [the reed] ab initio -- all agree it is forbidden
putting it back -- all agree it is permitted
where they disagree is [a reed] cut but not fitted
the one who forbids: we decree, lest he come to cut ab initio
the one who permits: we do not decree
[the Rav/Shmuel dispute is] like the tannaitic dispute [that follows]
one may not cut a tube on Yom Tov
...and needless to say on Shabbat
if it fell, one puts it back on Shabbat
...and needless to say on Yom Tov
and R' Yoshiya is lenient
[the horn:] R' Yoshiya is lenient on the first clause, cutting the tube
[the horn:] R' Yoshiya is lenient on the last clause, putting it back
rather, the difference between them is [a tube] cut but not fitted
but [cutting it] he is fashioning a vessel
one master holds: we decree
the other master holds: we do not decree
the halakha follows R' Yoshiya
